title: City Block
description: A living isometric city block builds from a grid of connected buildings, ideal for communicating platforms, territories and urban-scale systems.

defaultProps.tagline: See the system behind every street, block, and signal.

title: Cloud Stack
description: Layered cloud nodes rise through an isometric infrastructure map with animated routes and a highlighted service handoff.

defaultProps.tagline: Turn invisible infrastructure into a story people can see.

title: Workflow Room
description: A room-by-room workflow map reveals stages, owners and handoffs as a calm isometric operations walkthrough.

defaultProps.tagline: Make every handoff visible from first brief to final result.

title: Data Center
description: Server towers pulse across a technical isometric data center while routed connections explain resilient infrastructure.

defaultProps.tagline: A clear view of the machinery that keeps the product moving.

title: App Ecosystem
description: A central product node connects companion apps and capabilities in a tactile isometric ecosystem diagram.

defaultProps.tagline: Show how every feature becomes part of a bigger whole.

title: Factory Line
description: A production line moves from station to station with animated routes, pulsing checkpoints and clear throughput labels.

defaultProps.tagline: Make the journey from raw material to finished work impossible to miss.

title: Team Desk
description: A collaborative team desk scene uses small workstations and a connected path to visualize roles, context and shared momentum.

defaultProps.tagline: Give every contributor a place in the story and the system.

title: Warehouse Flow
description: A warehouse flow sends packages across a clear isometric route from intake to dispatch with active checkpoints.

defaultProps.tagline: Turn logistics into an understandable, memorable sequence.

title: Isometric Map
description: A terrain-like isometric map reveals routes and highlighted locations as a flexible geographic or territory explainer.

defaultProps.tagline: Place every milestone in context with a map that moves with the story.

title: Service Network
description: A service network brings nodes online one by one, making dependencies and the active path legible at a glance.

defaultProps.tagline: Trace the signal from one critical service to the next.
